title: Shortened adjectives
rule: Before a masculine singular noun: bueno → buen, malo → mal, primero → primer, tercero → tercer, alguno → algún, ninguno → ningún, uno → un.
grande → gran before any singular noun (un gran hombre, una gran mujer); gran before the noun means great, grande after it means big.
ciento → cien before a noun or mil: cien euros, cien mil personas.

questions: Before a masculine singular noun: primer piso.
Before a masculine singular noun: tercer lugar.
Before a singular noun, grande becomes gran (= great).
gran is used before feminine nouns too.
Before a masculine singular noun: ningún.
Before a masculine singular noun: algún.
Before a noun, ciento becomes cien.
After the noun, grande stays grande (= big).
With no noun after it, ninguno keeps its full form.
